audit_scope.method: Read-only inspection of acquired local Git refs, pinned source blobs and current ht61 documentation; no model execution, checkout editing, commit, push or remote server access.
audit_scope.root_live_verification: Root agent reported live GitHub verification: PR52 head remains e3c5e957c3769b5fc6867b42a52facace647a83b, open and unmerged; integration head remains b2527f12924a53da7334afbe78c752c101814193. This subagent independently inspected local pinned blobs only.
limitations: Not a complete audit of unpushed changes, private scripts or inaccessible remote compute state.
No new PPL, training, RTL, device or PPA measurement was performed.
Current TLM documentation and actual model-quality code use different numerical backends and must not be conflated.

source_pins.role: Frozen upstream source identity and byte-identical vendor declaration.
Illustrative uncharacterized macro contract, not measured timing, power or area.

current_ctmc.input: Candidate logits s_i = q dot k_i / sqrt(d); all valid candidate K vectors have already been read and exact candidate QK computed.
current_ctmc.reference: r = argmax_i s_i; delta_i = s_i - s_r for i != r. Selecting max is a reference-state shift, not Softmax normalization.
current_ctmc.states: The empty bit state represents category r; one active bit i represents category i. Hard inhibition permits only empty or single-active legal states.

rates.generator: Q[r,i] = a_i; Q[i,r] = b_i; diagonals are minus row sums; no direct transitions between two non-reference active states.
rates.time_unit: Each physical site has a unit-rate Poisson update clock. Times are dimensionless site-clock units, not physical ns, ASIC cycles or effective independent sample counts.

stationary_proof: Detailed balance gives pi_i / pi_r = a_i / b_i = exp(delta_i).
Therefore pi_r = 1 / (1 + sum_{i!=r} exp(delta_i)) and pi_i = exp(delta_i) * pi_r = exp(s_i) / sum_j exp(s_j).
This proof uses a partition function mathematically; the sampler does not explicitly evaluate that partition function or the Softmax target vector.
Stationarity is not a proof that a finite initialized chain has mixed or yielded independent samples.
current_ctmc.equivalent_energy: E(b) = -sum_{i!=r} delta_i*b_i + lambda*sum_{i<j} b_i*b_j, lambda -> infinity, at unit temperature. Finite lambda permits illegal multi-active states and is a different physical model.
current_ctmc.software_event_compression: torch.multinomial draws among unnormalized birth event rates; exponential empty and active dwell times preserve CTMC occupation and correlation. It is not target-Softmax IID sampling, and eliminating null events in software does not establish a corresponding hardware speedup.
current_ctmc.initial_state: Maximum-score category represented by empty state.
current_ctmc.default_observations: burn=16; spacing=4; t_k = 16 + 4*k for k=1..S. First observation is t=20; horizon is 16+4*S (S128 -> 528; S512 -> 2064).
current_ctmc.hardware_cost_boundary: Map site clocks, inhibition feedback, rate/bias generation, state readout and correlations to measured or characterized hardware. A literal unit-clock implementation has expected (M-1)*horizon site-clock attempts; event-compressed software event counts are not a replacement for that clocking cost unless an event-driven hardware design is specified.
excluded_physics: Finite inhibition strength and nonzero illegal-state mass in the main PPL path.
Feedback and wire delay, asynchronous races, device-specific bias transfer and bias quantization.

model_scope.screening: 64-token blocks, four 16-token mean-K summaries, max4 proxy, historical train-calibrated sigmoid/Bernoulli selection, mandatory first/last-two blocks, eight-block quota repair; up to 512 valid candidate tokens.
model_scope.attention: All installed layers use the replacement for single-token cached decode. Multi-token prefill remains original accurate SDPA.
model_scope.retained_modules: Original QKV projections, RoPE, complete KV cache, Wo and residual path remain. FFN state must be declared independently: PR52 uses stratified FFN variants whereas the frozen upstream Attention controller originally requires unchanged Qwen2MLP at installation.
model_scope.v_output: Sample local category indices, map to original KV positions, gather selected V rows, FP32 mean then restore model dtype. There is no second PV sampler.
model_scope.digital_controls: screen_iid explicitly uses candidate Softmax then IID categorical sampling; screen_exact uses candidate Softmax/PV; digital_sdpa preserves original BF16 SDPA wrapper.

tlm_oracle_distinction.interface: IsingMacro accepts candidate scores and emits local category indices with modeled configuration, settle, burn, sample and readout timing.
tlm_oracle_distinction.default_numerical_backend: ideal_iid_oracle -> categorical(softmax(logits)) generates workload addresses. This is not actual model-level finite-time CTMC or simulated digital Softmax hardware.
tlm_oracle_distinction.hardware_bill: The macro contract bundles internal random sources, state, inhibition feedback and index encoder. Bias-plus-validity programming is charged for full provisioned capacity, even masked slots; external scratch backpressure can lengthen the sample period.
tlm_oracle_distinction.illustrative_values: settle=500 ns, burn=2000 ns, sample period=100 ns and all configured power/area coefficients are explicitly uncharacterized examples. They are not measurements and cannot be mapped from CTMC burn16/spacing4 without characterization.

encoding_boundaries.encoding: Empty reference plus one-hot non-reference bits
encoding_boundaries.opportunity: Direct O(M) score-bias representation with local sigmoid heat-bath rates.
encoding_boundaries.costs: M-1 bits, score and validity programming, inhibition, asynchronous feedback, readout and settling. Pairwise inhibition can be algebraically expressed by broadcasting active count, but physical broadcast cost and timing remain.

Arbitrary M-category energies generally require higher-order terms, ancillas, an energy table or a restricted learned family. Nine bits have only 46 quadratic coefficients including constant versus 511 free log-probability ratios for M512; eleven bits have 67 versus 2047 for M2048. Fewer state bits do not establish cheap arbitrary energy evaluation or fast mixing.

encoding_boundaries.opportunity: A sampled address may require only O(log M) branch decisions.
encoding_boundaries.costs: Exact reproduction of arbitrary Softmax through branch probabilities requires subtree partition masses. Learned branch gates can approximate those probabilities without exact subtree logsumexp, but change the attention law and need distillation/PPL validation plus dynamic KV insertion, summary, routing and storage costs. No tree-logsumexp path was found to be the audited current CTMC implementation.

kv_boundaries.k: Current CTMC replacement still reads all candidate K vectors and computes all candidate QK scores. Eliminating explicit Softmax does not itself reduce this candidate K traffic.
kv_boundaries.v: V reads can follow actual sampled positions, with repetition removal and burst coalescing accounted for. Quality depends on the V-output estimator, not only sampled category frequencies.
kv_boundaries.gqa: Qwen has seven Q heads per KV head; candidate K traffic follows the union within a KV group rather than per-Q-head retention. V indices also require group/layout/burst accounting.
kv_boundaries.cache: The full historical KV cache remains stored; sampling does not automatically evict or compress it.
kv_boundaries.larger_savings_requirement: To reduce K traffic further, the learned energy must use genuinely cheaper cached features, hierarchy or improved screening. A renamed dense scorer or post-QK energy transformation does not establish that saving.

proposal_interpretation.P0: E_i=-score_i with native physical sampling is conceptually already the current Ising behavior target; hardware validation remains open and training is not mathematically required for the stationary target.
proposal_interpretation.P1: Learn hardware-constrained low-bit/low-dimensional energies, per-head temperature/bias or finite-time update parameters and distill Attention output plus LM loss through actual short sampling trajectories. This is a distinct research change with plausible accuracy-cost tradeoffs, not yet implemented or validated here.
proposal_interpretation.P2: Learn hierarchical/sparse-factor energies that avoid accurate QK on every candidate, with explicit state encoding, dynamic cache updates and transition costs. Larger potential benefit but higher architectural and training risk.
proposal_interpretation.recommended_controls: Initially keep current screening and original FFN fixed; compare exact score-energy, quantized score-energy and learned energy with matched exact/long-chain versus short-chain controls, then separately add learned screening and finally stratified FFN. Keep energy approximation, sampling error and screening loss separately diagnosable.
